description: This file implements the GstWebAudioPlayer class, which manages a GStreamer-based Web Audio player pipeline, including creation, configuration, control, and cleanup of the pipeline and its elements within the Rialto server project.

classes.name: GstWebAudioPlayer
classes.description: A class managing a GStreamer pipeline for Web Audio playback, including creation, configuration, control, and cleanup of the pipeline elements, as well as thread management and message handling.

methods.name: initWebAudioPipeline
methods.description: Initializes the GStreamer pipeline with appropriate elements and sink based on available features.

methods.name: createAmlhalaSink
methods.description: Creates and configures an amlhalasink element for the pipeline.

methods.name: createRtkAudioSink
methods.description: Creates and configures an rtkaudiosink element for the pipeline.

methods.name: createAutoSink
methods.description: Creates and configures an autoaudiosink element for the pipeline.

methods.name: linkElementsToSrc
methods.description: Links the source element to sink elements via converter and resample elements.

methods.name: termWebAudioPipeline
methods.description: Terminates and cleans up the Web Audio GStreamer pipeline.

methods.name: resetWorkerThread
methods.description: Enqueues shutdown task, joins, and resets the worker thread.

methods.name: setCaps
methods.description: Enqueues a task to set the audio capabilities and configuration.

methods.name: play
methods.description: Enqueues a task to start playback.

methods.name: pause
methods.description: Enqueues a task to pause playback.

methods.name: setVolume
methods.description: Enqueues a task to set the playback volume.

methods.name: getVolume
methods.description: Retrieves the current volume level; must be called on the main thread.

methods.name: writeBuffer
methods.description: Writes audio buffer data to the pipeline, with timeout handling.

methods.name: getQueuedBytes
methods.description: Returns the number of bytes currently queued in the appsrc element.

methods.name: changePipelineState
methods.description: Changes the pipeline state to the specified new state.

methods.name: stopWorkerThread
methods.description: Stops the worker thread if active.

methods.name: handleBusMessage
methods.description: Enqueues a task to handle a GStreamer bus message.
